questions.skill: 副词修饰范围 + straight up
questions.q: When reporters asked why the product launch had been delayed, the engineer was surprisingly straight up: “We underestimated the testing time.” Her manner was best described as:
o: frank
impulsive
ceremonial
hostile

exp.trans: 记者问产品为什么延期发布时，这位工程师出人意料地直截了当：“我们低估了测试所需的时间。”她的表达方式最适合形容为坦率。
exp.structure: 主句：the engineer（主语）+ was（系动词）+ surprisingly straight up（表语）。surprisingly修饰straight up，回答“出人意料地怎么样”。冒号后的直接引语具体证明她没有遮掩原因。
exp.other: product launch 产品发布；delay 推迟；underestimate 低估；testing time 测试时间。
exp.meaning: straight up在这里表示坦率、直截了当；surprisingly只表示这种坦率令人意外，不等于“冲动”。
exp.rest: impulsive表示冲动、未经充分考虑就行动，通常描述decision/action；ceremonial表示仪式性的；hostile表示敌对的。三者都不能由“直接承认低估测试时间”推出。

questions.q:
After years in the sunlight, only a faint line remained on the old map.
这里 faint 最接近哪种意思？
o: 神圣的
突然出现的
隐约的、不清晰的
故意伪造的

exp.trans: 经过多年日晒，旧地图上只剩下一条隐约可见的线。
exp.structure: After years in the sunlight是时间背景。only a faint line（主语）+ remained（不及物谓语）；on the old map是地点状语。
exp.other: sunlight 阳光；remain 留下、仍然存在；line 线条；after years 多年之后。
exp.meaning: faint在这里是微弱、不明显的；与faint praise中赞扬力度很弱具有相近的语义核心。
exp.rest: 神圣的常用holy/sacred；圣人是saint，不是faint。突然出现的可说sudden，重点是发生速度，不是清晰度。伪造的可说forged/fake，描述真伪，原句没有这种信息。

questions.q: Which sentence has a clean parallel structure in which the same modal verb governs both alternatives?
o: The technician can either replace the sensor or recalibrate the device.
The technician either can replace the sensor or recalibration of the device.
The technician can either replacing the sensor or recalibrate the device.
The technician can either replace the sensor or the device is recalibrated.

exp.trans: 正确句：技术员可以要么更换传感器，要么重新校准设备。
exp.structure: 主干：The technician（主语）+ can（情态动词）+ either replace... or recalibrate...。can同时支配replace和recalibrate，两边都是动词原形，结构完全平行。
exp.other: technician 技术员；sensor 传感器；recalibrate 重新校准；device 设备。
exp.meaning: 共同动词支配时，并列两端应保持同一语法层级。这里 can + replace / recalibrate。
exp.rest: either can replace... or recalibration... 把动词结构和名词结构并列；can either replacing... 中情态动词后不能接-ing形式；replace... or the device is recalibrated 把动词短语和完整从句并列，层级不一致。

questions.q:
The plumber thanked the neighbour. He had borrowed a ladder from the neighbour.
哪句合并正确？
o: The plumber thanked the neighbour from that he had borrowed a ladder.
The plumber thanked the neighbour whom from he had borrowed a ladder.
The plumber thanked the neighbour from whom he had borrowed a ladder.
The plumber thanked the neighbour whom he had borrowed a ladder from him.

exp.trans: 水管工感谢了那位借梯子给他的邻居。
exp.structure: 原始简单句：He had borrowed a ladder from the neighbour. → 用whom替代重复的the neighbour：the neighbour whom he had borrowed a ladder from → 把from前置：the neighbour from whom he had borrowed a ladder。外层主干是The plumber + thanked + the neighbour，后接修饰neighbour的定语从句。
exp.other: plumber 水管工；neighbour 邻居；ladder 梯子；borrow A from B 从B那里借来A。
exp.meaning: from不是临时猜出来的，来自原句borrow...from...；先行词是人，介词后用whom。
exp.rest: from that：关系代词that不能直接置于介词后。whom from he：介词前置时必须是from whom，不是whom from。from him：关系代词whom已经代替该人，再保留him造成重复。

questions.q: The child ___ to the railing while the boat crossed the rough water; he did not try to ___ it.
o: climbed / cling
clung / climb
clung / clung
climbed / climb

exp.trans: 船驶过颠簸水面时，孩子紧紧抓住栏杆；他并没有试图爬上去。
exp.structure: 第一分句：The child + clung to + the railing。第二分句：he + did not try + to climb + it。clung是cling的过去式；climb是不定式原形。
exp.other: railing 栏杆；rough water 风浪较大的水面；cross 穿过；try to do 试图做。
exp.meaning: cling → clung表示抓紧不放；climb表示向上爬。两个词形相近但动作完全不同。
exp.rest: climbed to the railing更像“爬到栏杆处”，不符合抓稳身体；try to cling it缺少介词to且语义不对；两个都用clung无法表达第二句“爬”。

questions.target: be subject to / be subjected to
questions.skill: be subject to / be subjected to
questions.q: 需要写一句仍适用的票务规则：“发车时间可能调整。”这里只说明可能性，不报告已经执行的处理。哪句准确？
o: Departure times were subjected to repeated adjustments yesterday.
Departure times are subject to change.
Departure times are subjected to a detailed inspection every morning.
Departure times are immune to change.

exp.trans: Departure times are subject to change：发车时间可能发生调整。
exp.structure: Departure times（主语）+ are（系动词）+ subject to change（表语）。这里是规则或可能状态，不是在叙述谁已经对时刻表做了什么处理。
exp.other: departure 出发；adjustment 调整；inspection 检查；be immune to 不受……影响。
exp.meaning: be subject to在这条规则中表示可能受变化影响。be subjected to通常强调某对象被施加了某个过程。
exp.rest: were subjected to repeated adjustments yesterday：报告昨天实际经历了反复调整，时态和事件性质均不符。are subjected to a detailed inspection：说每天被施加检查过程，inspection也不是时间可能调整。are immune to change：表示不受变化影响，与题意相反。

questions.target: belief / rule / considered ≠ 行为事实
questions.q: The article states: “The old rule of thumb was that athletes should avoid strength training during the season.” What can you safely conclude?
o: No athlete ever lifted weights during the season.
Coaches once commonly advised against in-season strength training.
Strength training was banned by every sports federation.
Athletes who trained during the season were always injured.

exp.trans: 文章说：“过去的经验法则认为，运动员赛季期间应避免力量训练。”安全的结论是：教练界过去普遍有这种建议。
exp.structure: 主干：The old rule of thumb + was + that从句。that athletes should avoid...说明规则/建议内容。should表达规范性判断，而不是历史行为统计。
exp.other: rule of thumb 经验法则；athlete 运动员；strength training 力量训练；in-season 赛季期间的。
exp.meaning: 规范、建议和传统观念只能支持“有人这样主张/建议”，不能自动推出所有人都遵守。
exp.rest: No athlete ever和every federation都是绝对化扩大；always injured把建议背后的风险偷换成必然结果。

questions.q:
A return is accepted only within thirty days and with a receipt. These requirements apply to online orders too.
These requirements 具体指什么？
o: 网上订单本身
所有商店的规定
三十天以内退货且出示收据这两个条件
退款已经完成这一结果

exp.trans: 只有在三十天内并出示收据，退货才会被受理。这些要求也适用于网上订单。
exp.structure: 第一句：A return（主语）+ is accepted（被动谓语）；only within thirty days和with a receipt并列限制受理条件。第二句：These requirements（主语）+ apply（谓语）+ to online orders（介词短语）。
exp.other: return 退货；receipt 收据；apply to 适用于；online order 网上订单。
exp.meaning: these + 名词可以概括前文的整组条件，不一定只指紧挨着它的一个名词。
exp.rest: online orders是第二句中被这些要求约束的对象，不是要求本身。所有商店的规定扩大了范围，原文未说all shops。退款完成是结果，但前句只陈述受理规则，没有报告任何实际退款。

directness-modifier.target: come right out and say / frank
directness-modifier.q: Instead of giving a vague excuse for the exhibition's cancellation, the curator came right out and said that ticket sales had been too low. This response was:
o: evasive
frank
impulsive
indifferent

exp.trans: 这位策展人没有用含糊的借口解释展览取消，而是直接说票卖得太少了。这种回应是坦率的。
exp.structure: Instead of giving...是介词短语作对比背景。主干：the curator（主语）+ came right out and said（谓语）+ that从句（宾语）。that ticket sales had been too low说明她直接说出的真实原因。
exp.other: vague excuse 含糊的借口；curator 策展人；cancellation 取消；ticket sales 票房/售票量。
exp.meaning: come right out and say = 直截了当地说；语气上对应frank，而不是回避。
exp.rest: evasive表示闪烁其词、回避，和instead of a vague excuse相反；impulsive强调冲动行为；indifferent表示冷漠、不在意，原句没有这种态度。

faint.q: After a two-hour presentation, Maya said, “Well, at least the slides were readable.” Her remark is best described as:
o: faint praise
earnest approval
open hostility
sufficient evidence

diag.1: earnest approval 是真诚而明确的赞许；“at least...”只给了很弱的一点肯定。
diag.2: 这句话并非直接敌意攻击，而是非常有限、勉强的表扬。
diag.3: evidence 是“证据”，不是评价语气。

exp.trans: 听完一场两小时的演讲后，Maya 说：“嗯，至少幻灯片还看得清。”这句话最适合形容为“勉强的赞扬”。
exp.structure: Maya（主语）+ said（谓语）+ 引语（内容）。问句 Her remark is best described as... 中 is described是被动谓语，不是is加形容词表语。引语主干为the slides were readable；at least限制了肯定的力度。
exp.other: presentation 演讲/展示；readable 易读的；remark 评论；at least 至少。
exp.meaning: faint praise = 勉强的、力度很弱的赞扬。这里 faint 的核心是“微弱的、不强的”。
exp.rest: earnest approval = 真诚、明确的赞成，语气过强；open hostility = 公开敌意，不符合；sufficient evidence = 充分证据，词义类别都不对。只有 faint praise（力度很弱的赞扬）符合 at least 的保留语气。

faint.q:
Calling the volunteers' six-month restoration project “not entirely useless” struck the team as faint praise.
哪句改写最准确？
o: The team heard an enthusiastic celebration of the project.
The comment offered only a very weak form of approval.
The comment proved that the project had failed completely.
The team was told that the project had won an award.

exp.trans: 把志愿者历时六个月的修复项目说成“并非完全没有用”，让团队觉得这只是很勉强的赞扬。
exp.structure: Calling the volunteers' six-month restoration project ‘not entirely useless’是整个动名词短语主语；struck是谓语；the team是宾语；as faint praise表示给团队留下何种印象。短语内部call A B：称A为B。
exp.other: restoration 修复；entirely 完全；strike sb as sth 给某人以某种印象；approval 赞许。
exp.meaning: faint praise并非赞扬完全不存在，而是肯定得很有限，甚至暗含保留意见。
exp.rest: enthusiastic celebration表示热情赞颂，力度过强；had failed completely表示彻底失败，把微弱肯定改成全面否定；had won an award表示获奖，原文没有提供获奖事实。

relative.q:
The archive contains several letters. The historian based her argument on those letters.
最自然的合并是：
o: The archive contains several letters on which the historian based her argument.
The archive contains several letters which on the historian based her argument.
The archive contains several letters on that the historian based her argument.
The archive contains several letters which the historian based her argument on them.

diag.1: 介词 on 应放在关系代词 which 前，不能写 which on the historian...
diag.2: 介词后不能用关系代词 that；应使用 which。
diag.3: which 已经代替 those letters，后面再用 them 造成重复。

exp.trans: 这个档案馆收藏着几封信，历史学家正是依据这些信件提出了她的论证。
exp.structure: 原始简单句：The historian based her argument on those letters. → those letters 变成先行词 several letters，并用 which 代替：the letters which the historian based her argument on → 正式写法把介词前置：the letters on which the historian based her argument。
exp.other: archive 档案馆；historian 历史学家；base A on B 以B为依据建立A；argument 论证/观点。
exp.meaning: 介词 + which 用于物；介词来自原简单句中的搭配 base A on B。
exp.rest: 介词前置的正确句是 “letters on which ...”；把 which 放在 on 前、把 that 放在介词后，或在 which 后再保留 them，都会造成词序或关系词重复问题。

cling-climb.q: Even after the company simplified its procedures, a few managers continued to cling to the old rules. Here, cling to means:
o: 向上攀爬
紧抓着不愿放弃
公开批评
快速修改

exp.trans: 即使公司简化了流程，仍有少数经理继续死守旧规定。
exp.structure: Even after...是让步背景。主干：a few managers（主语）+ continued（谓语）+ to cling to the old rules（补足内容）。cling to的宾语是the old rules。
exp.other: simplify 简化；procedure 流程；continue to do 继续做；old rules 旧规定。
exp.meaning: cling to = 紧抓、依恋、不愿放弃。注意cling不是climb。
exp.rest: climb才是“攀爬”；公开批评是criticize openly；快速修改是revise quickly。这里语境是明知规则已简化仍不愿放弃旧做法。

subject.target: subject A to B / be subjected to
subject.skill: be subject to / be subjected to
subject.q:
The cleaner deliberately subjected the curtains to a steam treatment yesterday.
要保留“昨天实际施加了处理”的含义，哪句被动改写准确？
o: The curtains are subject to changes in fashion.
The curtains were exempt from treatment yesterday.
The curtains were subjected to a steam treatment by the cleaner yesterday.
The curtains are suitable for steam treatment.

exp.trans: 清洁人员昨天特意对窗帘做了蒸汽处理。被动句：窗帘昨天被清洁人员进行了蒸汽处理。
exp.structure: 主动简单句：The cleaner（主语）+ subjected（谓语）+ the curtains（宾语）+ to a steam treatment。→ 把宾语the curtains提升为被动句主语，把subjected改成were subjected，并用by保留施事：The curtains were subjected to a steam treatment by the cleaner yesterday。
exp.other: cleaner 清洁人员；curtain 窗帘；deliberately 特意地；steam treatment 蒸汽处理。
exp.meaning: subject A to B表示使A经历B；变成被动结构就是A be subjected to B，实际处理过程仍然保留。
exp.rest: are subject to changes in fashion：说窗帘可能受时尚变化影响，不是昨天被处理的事件。were exempt from treatment：免于处理，与原文相反。are suitable for steam treatment：适合做处理，只表示适宜性，不能证明处理发生过。

viewpoint-fact.target: 传统观念 ≠ 实际行为事实
viewpoint-fact.q: A report says: “For years, the conventional wisdom was that renting a small office was safer than buying one.” Which statement is justified?
o: Every small business rented its office for years.
There was a widespread belief that renting was safer.
Buying an office was legally forbidden.
Businesses that bought offices always failed.

exp.trans: 报告说：“多年来，传统观念认为租一间小办公室比买一间更安全。”能够成立的是：曾经存在一种广泛观念，认为租赁更安全。
exp.structure: 主干：the conventional wisdom（主语）+ was（系动词）+ that从句（表语）。that从句说明“观念的内容”，不是统计所有企业实际做了什么。
exp.other: conventional wisdom 传统看法/普遍观念；rent 租；buy 购买；widespread 广泛的。
exp.meaning: belief/rule/considered safer描述的是人们怎么想，不能直接推成“所有人过去都这么做”。
exp.rest: Every把范围扩大成全部企业；legally forbidden把“认为不安全”偷换成法律禁止；always failed把风险判断偷换成必然失败，都是证据过头。

reference.q:
段A：The museum lowered ticket prices and added evening hours.
段B：Such changes attracted more local families during the week.
段C：A different museum across town raised its prices last year.

段B中的 Such changes 最直接回指什么？
o: 段A中的降价和延长晚间开放时间
段C中另一家博物馆的涨价
所有博物馆过去一年的变化
local families 本身

diag.1: 段B先于段C，且 Such changes 就近概括段A的两个措施。
diag.2: 题干没有支持“所有博物馆”的泛指。
diag.3: changes 指的是措施变化，不是家庭。

exp.trans: A：博物馆降低了票价，并延长了晚间开放时间。B：这些变化吸引了更多本地家庭在工作日前来。C：城另一边的另一家博物馆去年提高了票价。
exp.structure: 段A先给出两个并列措施 lowered ticket prices / added evening hours；段B用 Such changes 对这两个措施整体回指，再说明结果 attracted more local families。
exp.other: lower 降低；ticket price 票价；evening hours 晚间开放时段；attract 吸引。
exp.meaning: such + 名词 常把前文已经描述过的同类事物/情况概括回指；这里 Such changes = 段A的两项变化。
exp.rest: 后文另一家博物馆的涨价、所有博物馆的泛指以及 local families 都不是 Such changes 的先行内容；它直接概括前文的降价和延长晚间开放时间。

reference.target: these/such 回指 / 原词复现干扰
reference.skill: 原词复现 vs 明确回指
reference.q:
段A：The team lost radio contact, and its spare battery failed.
段B：These failures forced the team to abandon the search.
段C：Another team tested a radio before leaving camp.

哪两个段落之间的衔接最强？
o: A → C
B → C
C → A
A → B

exp.trans: 段A：团队失去了无线电联系，备用电池也出了故障。段B：这些故障迫使团队放弃搜寻。段C：另一支团队离开营地前测试了一台无线电设备。
exp.structure: 段A有两个并列分句：The team + lost + radio contact；its spare battery + failed。段B：These failures（主语，概括前面的两项故障）+ forced（谓语）+ the team（宾语）+ to abandon the search（宾语补足语）。段C的Another team引入另一对象。
exp.other: radio contact 无线电联系；spare 备用的；abandon 放弃；search 搜寻。
exp.meaning: These failures明确回指已出现的两次故障；重复radio一词并不保证谈的是同一团队、同一事件。
exp.rest: 把两个含radio的句子相接，会忽略Another team造成的对象切换。把这些故障放在另一团队测试设备之前，后句没有承接故障结果。先说另一团队测试再说本团队出故障，也没有明确回指建立连接。
